statements.markdown: **Theorem 5.7 (Residue-class support).** *For integers $b\ge2$, $m\ge1$ and $c$, the series $\sum_{n\ge1,\ n\equiv c\pmod m}(b^n-1)^{-1}$ is irrational.*
